discover_plugins: discover and load all plugins from bundled, user, project, and pip entry-point sources
invoke_hook: invoke a lifecycle hook callback on all loaded plugins and return non-None results
get_plugin_command_handler: get the handler function for a plugin-registered slash command by name
get_pre_tool_call_block_message: check pre_tool_call hooks for a blocking directive to prevent tool execution
get_plugin_toolsets: get plugin toolsets as tuples of key, label, and description for the tools TUI
